rows.en: Once Gorgom has its eye on you, there's no escaping! Gorgom is a band of devils!
And you sold us… to that band of devils!

Obeying Gorgom is the only way to survive, Kotaro!

In the world to come, only those chosen by Gorgom will be allowed to live! Mankind will be culled!

Kotaro, you and Nobuhiko at least… become Gorgom's Century Kings and survive!

I refuse! I'll never obey them!

Look at this body of mine, Dad. They modified me, I'm not a normal human anymore. How can something like this be allowed!?

Those bastards… they're trying to steal humanity's freedom!
Kotaro!!
Guaaaah!
Waaaaagh!
Dad!!
Kyoko… Ugh… Take care of… Nobuhiko…
Daaaaad!!
Guh…!!
I am Gorgom's Century King, Black Sun… No… I am Kamen Riderrr… BLAAACK!
Is everyone safe?
Yeah, we're fine…

Good to hear…

By the way, who are you two?
I'm Raita Narukami… I do research on lightning here at the Narukami Lightning Laboratory.
But you're still a kid… Isn't that a little too hard for you?
Not at all. Raita is a genius child with an IQ of 250. His brain is built differently from yours.
Tch… Yeah, yeah, I guess I'm all muscle, right up into my head!
And you are?
I'm Hikaru Inazuma… Raita's assistant.
She may be my assistant… but she holds lots of doctorates.
Whoa… That's how women should be from now on! Totally different from a certain somebody.
And what's that supposed to mean!?
Research on lightning? What sort of research?
To put it simply, research into converting the electric current of lightning into energy.
Why would you do that?
As you know, lightning is electricity drawn together by plus and minus.

Plus and minus, huh…

Magnets are made of plus and minus too, aren't they? And batteries and such, too…

You're quite sharp… aren't you?

Exactly… We've been gathering the lightning's energy using lightning rods that exploit that property.

(Something's off…? Genius or not, a little kid doing research like this…

All right, I'll have Commander Kom look into it…)
How is the Beast Aliens' ultrasonic whistle coming along?

Sir…

We are working together with DARK's Professor Gill, and development is currently proceeding at full speed.
Hurry the development of the ultrasonic whistle! We will make a bloody sacrifice of those Space Sheriffs.

Fortunately, Fuuma's Commander Hessler is said to have obtained Ozuma!

With the Kyurians' esper powers, the ultrasonic whistle is as good as complete…
Very good… I look forward to good news.
Is it around here, [HERO4]?

Yes…

According to the command satellite's survey data, there was another high energy reading, though only for an instant…
Isn't it just another mutant or something?

No…

It's a higher energy reading than with Hongo or Hayato… or even Shiro.
…I think.
"You think"? Did you really sense power that strong?
Yeah. To be honest, it's bad news! I mean, it's the strongest I've ever sensed…

A cyborg…

So… that black one is one too!?
That one's a cyborg too…?
Nuooooh!!
Sharivan, about that boy you asked us to investigate, Raita Narukami… It seems he's a refugee from Planet Lake.
Planet Lake?
It's another 15 light-years beyond Planet Bird.
So that boy came all the way from such a distant planet, then?

And we believe that boy may be Ben, the son of Dr. Barnes…

Dr. Barnes was a nuclear physicist on Planet Lake. He was developing the Radiation Clean System to protect life from radioactive contamination.

And… Madou set its sights on that system!
Madou did…!?

Naturally, Dr. Barnes refused.

Makuu attacked Planet Lake to seize the system by force. Sensing he was in danger, Dr. Barnes fled to Earth with his son, Ben!

The name Raita Narukami is an alias to hide his identity…
Then the lightning research too?

Most likely it's for camouflage.

Sharivan! Protect Dr. Barnes and his son Ben! Madou's evil clutches are reaching for them…

I've sent Gavan to protect Dr. Barnes! Join up with him…
Yes, sir!
Who's there?
Space Sheriff Gavan.
Gavan?
Makuu is after you! You're in danger if you stay like this.
Ugh, stay away!
We're on your side! We came to protect you and your son…
Commander Kom told me to join up with you…

I see…

Dr. Barnes, come with us…!?
What is this…!?
It was set up so the computer would respond to a human voice!
He was already dead…!?

…!?

These are the blueprints for the Radiation Clean System! After Dr. Barnes died, his son Ben must have taken over the research! And completed it!

That's Raita, then!

So he was the son of a nuclear physicist from Planet Lake… That's why, even though he's only 11, he could do research like that…

This is bad!

If Madou learns of this, they'll go after Raita!!
Ha ha ha… So Dr. Barnes was dead! No wonder we couldn't find him!
Madou will take the son, Ben! As for you, you can rot right here! Eliminate them!! Attack!
Captain! I heard from Commander Kom! We'll help too.

Right, I'm counting on you!

Johchaku!!
Sekisha!!
Ha ha ha… Damn you Space Sheriffs! Feel the power of Ozuma!!

Ha ha ha! I did it! Damn you Space Sheriffs! This is your grave!

Subjugate!! Ozuma, finish them off!!

uncertain: U06827: 杏子 is Kotaro's (adopted) sister Kyoko Akizuki; not in glossary.
U06830: [ja] rendered "Kamen Riderrr… BLAAACK!" (stretched form of glossary "Kamen Rider BLACK").
U06862/U06863: 改造人間 rendered "cyborg" in dialogue (in line with サイボーグ elsewhere); could be "modified human".
U06856: 指揮衛星 rendered "command satellite"; may be a glyph error (監視衛星 surveillance satellite?).
U06858: [ja] from [HERO4] rendered with honorifics dropped.
U06865: レイク星 rendered "Planet Lake" (katakana loanword reading); could be "Planet Reik".
U06892: Dai Sawamura calls Gavan 隊長, rendered "Captain".
U06897: Hessler's cry 征伐 rendered "Subjugate!!" (Fuuma battle cry).

new_names.why: from glossary 獣星人ダブルマン = Beast Alien Doubleman
